distinction.algebraic_target: exact fixed point of the named frozen-donor capacity map
distinction.physical_target: exact endpoint of the declared continuous finite reaction ODE
distinction.combined_collision_geometry_target: use the complete finite vector-field residual or an explicitly bounded splitting error

algebraic_certificate.evaluation_error: epsilon_eval>=norm(exact Phi evaluation - computed Phi evaluation)

required: same initial state, event columns, step and support
f and fhat bounded on same K
rate_perturbation_certificate.inputs: e_r>=sup_K abs(f_r-fhat_r), common F_r and common denominator lower m_r

required: same initial state unless supplied initial_error
computed z and actual path in convex K
G has uniform state Lipschitz L>=0 and time Lipschitz Lt>=0
physical_endpoint_certificate.A: expm1(L*h)/L if L>0; h if L=0
physical_endpoint_certificate.iteration_error_handling: Included through the actual z and physical endpoint residual; do not add the same algebraic error twice.
physical_endpoint_certificate.geometric_extension: Add known geometric field and its time dependence to G,L,Lt for a total-field reconstruction certificate.

local_consistency.one_step_state_error: sum of the two displayed remainder bounds
local_consistency.zero_donor: R_r(y_n)=0 and local Lipschitz rates imply missed birth-enabled extent O(h^2)

domain_guards.discrete_electron_floor: if N_e_n>0 and n_e=N_e/V_star, h*C_e_proposal<=N_e_n gives n_e_plus>=N_e_n/(2*V_star)
domain_guards.absent_species: Omit fraction descriptors with zero total nuclei
domain_guards.singular_rates: Positive temperature/density domain or an explicit regular extension with the smoothness actually used

prescribed_expansion.condition: same prescribed volume factors for the two compared states
